newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua to sign investment pact with Chile.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua to sign investment pact with Chile.

text.p: Nicaragua will sign an investment protection agreement with Chile on the eve of the Ibero-American Summit to be held in Chile this weekend, Nicaragua's foreign minister said on Wednesday.

"It is a reciprocal agreement to promote and protect investments. It means that any investments Chileans want to make in Nicaragua will be guaranteed and protected by an international mechanism," Foreign Minister Ernesto Leal told reporters. Leal said Nicaragua already has signed such investment protection agreements with the United States, Denmark, Spain, and Taiwan.
The agreements are to ease investor nervousness about Nicaragua, where some foreigners had their property confiscated during the 1979-1990 left-wing Sandinista government.
Leal said he and his Chilean counterpart, Jose Miguel Insulza, would sign the pact on Friday.
The annual summit joins the heads of state of Latin America, Spain and Portugal.
